name: 1-minute micro breakout scalp
description: Scalping price action on 1-minute candles: buy the break of a tiny swing high on a volume spike, out fast.

about.how_it_works: On one-minute candles, small swing highs mark short-term resistance. When a candle closes through that level with at least twice the usual volume, and its range is bigger than the last one, a burst of buying is under way. Scalps are short: the stop goes under the breakout candle, the target is 1.5 times the risk, and the trade ends after 15 minutes either way. Strict daily limits stop a bad session early.
about.works_best: Very liquid markets during active hours, with low fees.
about.fails_when: Fees and slippage are high relative to the tiny moves. At retail fees of 0.1% per fill, most scalping loses, so set fee_bps to your real rate before judging it.
